# Go Magic

> Go Magic is a comprehensive educational platform for learning Go (Baduk/Weiqi), offering courses from beginner to professional levels with expert instructors and interactive learning tools.

Go Magic provides structured learning paths, premium courses, private lessons with professional instructors like Vadim Efimenko and Alexander Dinerstein, and connections to online Go communities. The platform combines game fundamentals, strategy instruction, and cognitive development for players of all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Go (Baduk/Weiqi)
- Go Education
- Game Strategy
- Beginner Guide
- Go Fundamentals
- Skill Development
- Board Game
- Strategic Thinking
- Professional Instructors

- Game History
- Brain Health
- Interactive Tutorials

## Getting Started

- [Go Game | Baduk | Weiqi : Introduction to the Classic Board Game](https://gomagic.org/go-game): Introduction to Go/Baduk/Weiqi covering game history, strategy, and cognitive benefits.
- [How to Play Go: Rules Explained](https://gomagic.org/how-to-play-go-rules): Interactive tutorial explaining Go rules and fundamentals for beginners.
- [Go for Beginners: Online Guide to Mastering the Game](https://gomagic.org/beginners-guide): Comprehensive beginner's guide with learning path, tips, and game strategy.
- [Go Magic Roadmap – Future Plans and Upcoming Features](https://gomagic.org/roadmap): Learning roadmap from 30-kyu to 7-dan with planned features and courses.

## Learning & Instruction

- [Go Magic Premium](https://gomagic.org/premium): Premium subscription offering 50+ pro courses, daily tasks, and skill practice.
- [Free Content on Go Magic](https://gomagic.org/free): Free Go Magic courses and learning materials including fundamentals and rules.
- [Go Lessons with Vadim Efimenko 4-dan](https://gomagic.org/go-lessons): Customized private Go lessons with 4-dan instructor Vadim Efimenko.
- [Go Teachers – Meet the Instructors Behind Go Magic](https://gomagic.org/go-teachers): Profiles of professional Go instructors including Alexander Dinerstein and others.
